_comment: Registry of jurisdictions and their public data endpoints. A jurisdiction appears in the app only when verified:true in its rule table (rules/<slug>.json) and its endpoints and layers have been confirmed. Field names and URLs are recorded with the date last checked. No zoning value is ever stored here; rule values live in the per-jurisdiction rule tables produced by the ordinance source reader.
